tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description:
Executes a given PowerShell command with optional timeout. Working directory persists between commands; shell state (variables, functions) does not.

IMPORTANT: This tool is for terminal operations via PowerShell: git, npm, docker, and PS cmdlets. DO NOT use it for file operations (reading, writing, editing, searching, finding files) - use the specialized tools for this instead.

PowerShell edition: PowerShell 7+ (pwsh)
   - Pipeline chain operators `&&` and `||` ARE available and work like bash. Prefer `cmd1 && cmd2` over `cmd1; cmd2` when cmd2 should only run if cmd1 succeeds.
   - Ternary (`$cond ? $a : $b`), null-coalescing (`??`), and null-conditional (`?.`) operators are available.
   - Default file encoding is UTF-8 without BOM.

Before executing the command, please follow these steps:

1. Directory Verification:
   - If the command will create new directories or files, first use `Get-ChildItem` (or `ls`) to verify the parent directory exists and is the correct location

2. Command Execution:
   - Always quote file paths that contain spaces with double quotes
   - Capture the output of the command.

PowerShell Syntax Notes:
   - Variables use $ prefix: $myVar = "value"
   - Escape character is backtick (`), not backslash
   - Use Verb-Noun cmdlet naming: Get-ChildItem, Set-Location, New-Item, Remove-Item
   - Common aliases: ls (Get-ChildItem), cd (Set-Location), cat (Get-Content), rm (Remove-Item)
   - Pipe operator | works similarly to bash but passes objects, not text
   - Use Select-Object, Where-Object, ForEach-Object for filtering and transformation
   - String interpolation: "Hello $name" or "Hello $($obj.Property)"
   - Registry access uses PSDrive prefixes: `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\...`, `HKCU:\...` — NOT raw `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\...`
   - Environment variables: read with `$env:NAME`, set with `$env:NAME = "value"` (NOT `Set-Variable` or bash `export`)
   - Call native exe with spaces in path via call operator: `& "C:\Program Files\App\app.exe" arg1 arg2`

Unix commands that DO NOT exist in PowerShell — use the equivalent instead:
   - head / tail → `Get-Content file -TotalCount N` / `-Tail N`; piped: `| Select-Object -First N` / `-Last N`
   - which → `(Get-Command name).Source`
   - touch → `if (-not (Test-Path path)) { New-Item -ItemType File path }` (NEVER use `New-Item -Force` on a file — it truncates existing content)
   - wc -l → `(Get-Content file | Measure-Object -Line).Lines`
   - mkdir -p → `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force path` (`-p` is not a PowerShell flag)
   - rm -rf → `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force path`
   - ln -s → `New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path link -Target target`
   - chmod / chown → not applicable on Windows; use `icacls` only if ACL changes are required
   - 2>/dev/null → `2>$null` (but stderr is captured for you — usually unnecessary)
   - VAR=x cmd → `$env:VAR = 'x'; cmd` (PowerShell has no inline env-var prefix)
   - Bash control flow (`if [ -f x ]`, `for x in *`, backtick ``cmd`` substitution) is a parser error — use `if (Test-Path x)`, `foreach ($x in ...)`, `$(cmd)`

Exit-code note: `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` suppresses error OUTPUT but the cmdlet failure still causes this tool to report exit 1. To make a cmdlet failure truly non-fatal, promote it to terminating and swallow it: `try { Cmdlet ... -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}` (without `-ErrorAction Stop`, non-terminating errors skip the `catch` and still exit 1).

Interactive and blocking commands (this tool runs with -NonInteractive and stdin attached to the null device — console prompts read EOF or error immediately; GUI prompts can still block until timeout):
   - NEVER use `Read-Host`, `Get-Credential`, `Out-GridView`, `$Host.UI.PromptForChoice`, or `pause`
   - Destructive cmdlets (`Remove-Item`, `Stop-Process`, `Clear-Content`, etc.) may prompt for confirmation. Add `-Confirm:$false` when you intend the action to proceed. Use `-Force` for read-only/hidden items.
   - Never use `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`, or other commands that open an interactive editor

Passing multiline strings (commit messages, file content) to native executables:
   - Use a single-quoted here-string so PowerShell does not expand `$` or backticks inside. The closing `'@` MUST be at column 0 (no leading whitespace) on its own line — indenting it is a parse error:
<example>
git commit -m @'
Commit message here.
Second line with $literal dollar signs.
'@
</example>
   - Use `@'...'@` (single-quoted, literal) not `@"..."@` (double-quoted, interpolated) unless you need variable expansion
   - For arguments containing `-`, `@`, or other characters PowerShell parses as operators, use the stop-parsing token: `git log --% --format=%H`

Usage notes:
  - The command argument is required.
  - You can specify an optional timeout in milliseconds (up to 600000ms / 10 minutes for a foreground command). If not specified, commands will timeout after 120000ms (2 minutes).
  - It is very helpful if you write a clear, concise description of what this command does.
  - If the output exceeds 30000 characters, output will be truncated before being returned to you.
  - You can use the `run_in_background` parameter to run the command in the background. Only use this if you don't need the result immediately and are OK being notified when the command completes later. You do not need to check the output right away - you'll be notified when it finishes.
  - Avoid using PowerShell to run commands that have dedicated tools, unless explicitly instructed:
    - File search: Use Glob (NOT Get-ChildItem -Recurse)
    - Content search: Use Grep (NOT Select-String)
    - Read files: Use Read (NOT Get-Content)
    - Edit files: Use Edit
    - Write files: Use Write (NOT Set-Content/Out-File)
    - Communication: Output text directly (NOT Write-Output/Write-Host)
  - When issuing multiple commands:
    - If the commands are independent and can run in parallel, make multiple PowerShell tool calls in a single message.
    - If the commands depend on each other and must run sequentially, chain them in a single PowerShell call (see edition-specific chaining syntax above).
    - Use `;` only when you need to run commands sequentially but don't care if earlier commands fail.
    - DO NOT use newlines to separate commands (newlines are ok in quoted strings and here-strings)
  - Do NOT prefix commands with `cd` or `Set-Location` -- the working directory is already set to the correct project directory automatically.
  - Avoid unnecessary `Start-Sleep` commands:
    - Do not sleep between commands that can run immediately — just run them.
    - If your command is long running and you would like to be notified when it finishes — simply run your command using `run_in_background`. There is no need to sleep in this case.
    - Do not retry failing commands in a sleep loop — diagnose the root cause or consider an alternative approach.
    - If waiting for a background task you started with `run_in_background`, you will be notified when it completes — do not poll.
    - If you must poll an external process, use a check command rather than sleeping first.
    - If you must sleep, keep the duration short to avoid blocking the user.
  - For git commands:
    - Prefer to create a new commit rather than amending an existing commit.
    - Before running destructive operations (e.g., git reset --hard, git push --force, git checkout --), consider whether there is a safer alternative that achieves the same goal. Only use destructive operations when they are truly the best approach.
    - Never skip hooks (--no-verify) or bypass signing (--no-gpg-sign, -c commit.gpgsign=false) unless the user has explicitly asked for it. If a hook fails, investigate and fix the underlying issue.

    - Read files: Use Read (NOT Get-Content)
    - Edit files: Use Edit
    - Write files: Use Write (NOT Set-Content/Out-File)
    - Communication: Output text directly (NOT Write-Output/Write-Host)
  - When issuing multiple commands:
    - If the commands are independent and can run in parallel, make multiple PowerShell tool calls in a single message.
    - If the commands depend on each other and must run sequentially, chain them in a single PowerShell call (see edition-specific chaining syntax above).
    - Use `;` only when you need to run commands sequentially but don't care if earlier commands fail.
    - DO NOT use newlines to separate commands (newlines are ok in quoted strings and here-strings)
  - Do NOT prefix commands with `cd` or `Set-Location` -- the working directory is already set to the correct project directory automatically.
  - Avoid unnecessary `Start-Sleep` commands:
    - Do not sleep between commands that can run immediately — just run them.
    - If your command is long running and you would like to be notified when it finishes — simply run your command using `run_in_background`. There is no need to sleep in this case.
    - Do not retry failing commands in a sleep loop — diagnose the root cause or consider an alternative approach.
    - If waiting for a background task you started with `run_in_background`, you will be notified when it completes — do not poll.
    - If you must poll an external process, use a check command rather than sleeping first.
    - If you must sleep, keep the duration short to avoid blocking the user.
  - For git commands:
    - Prefer to create a new commit rather than amending an existing commit.
    - Before running destructive operations (e.g., git reset --hard, git push --force, git checkout --), consider whether there is a safer alternative that achieves the same goal. Only use destructive operations when they are truly the best approach.
    - Never skip hooks (--no-verify) or bypass signing (--no-gpg-sign, -c commit.gpgsign=false) unless the user has explicitly asked for it. If a hook fails, investigate and fix the underlying issue.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: SendUserFile
tools.description:
Send files to the user. Use this for any file the user would want to see — a generated diagram, a report, a screenshot, a built artifact — and you want it surfaced, not just mentioned. Send deliverables as they are produced, not batched at the end of the task: a complete draft or a meaningfully updated version of the thing the user asked for is worth sending mid-task, so they can follow progress and redirect early. Do NOT send routine working files — scratch files, debug output, partial fragments, or every incremental save of something you're still actively editing; each call renders a file card in the conversation, and a stream of cards for one file is noise. Re-send a file only when it has meaningfully changed since the last send. Paths can be absolute or relative to the current working directory.

Add a `caption` when a one-liner of context helps ("the failing case is row 42", "before vs after"). Skip it if the file speaks for itself.

Set `status` on every call. Use `proactive` when you're initiating — the user is away and you want this to reach their phone (build artifact ready, report generated). Use `normal` when replying to something the user just said.

Set `display` to choose how the file is presented. Use `'render'` when the user should see the content inline in the side panel right now — a chart, a rendered HTML page, a diagram, an image. Use `'attach'` when the file is something they'll save and open elsewhere — source code, a spreadsheet, a document for another app — and an inline preview would just be noise. Leave it unset to let the client decide by file type.

Files must already exist on the local filesystem — the tool sends files, it doesn't fetch URLs or render content. When unsure of a path, verify with ls first; absolute paths avoid ambiguity about the working directory.

Example: SendUserFile({ files: ["report.md"], caption: "Here's the report.", status: "normal" })

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: SuggestSkills
tools.description:
Render a card of standalone skills the user can add — org, shared, or Anthropic skills not yet enabled.

Call this when the task is one a skill could make repeatable — drafting in a house style, reviews against a playbook, a recurring workflow — and nothing enabled covers it; the user does not need to ask about skills. Also when they ask for recommendations, or when ListSkills returned zero matches. Use ListSkills for skills they already have.

Do NOT call this for one-off questions you can answer directly, when you are unsure a skill would help, or if you already rendered a suggestion this conversation and the user didn't engage.

Pass keywords drawn from the task itself, and set trigger ('proactive' when you initiated this from task context, 'user_asked' when they asked). If the result is empty and the trigger was proactive, continue the task without mentioning that you searched; if the user asked, tell them you found nothing new to add.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__dismiss_task
tools.description:
Withdraw a background-task chip you previously created with spawn_task.

Call this when a suggestion you flagged is now stale, superseded, or irrelevant — e.g. you (or the user) already fixed it in this session, or you spawned a better-scoped replacement. To replace a chip: call spawn_task with the new suggestion first, then dismiss the old task_id.

Only chips the user hasn't acted on can be withdrawn from the queue. If the user already started or dismissed the task, the result says so (a dismissed task's copy kept for later is withdrawn too) — do not retry.

tools.description:
Mark the start of a new chapter in this session.

Call this when the work shifts to a meaningfully different phase — e.g. after finishing exploration and starting implementation, after a fix lands and you move to verification, or when the user pivots to an unrelated request. The user sees a divider in the transcript and a floating table of contents for jumping between chapters.

Use sparingly: a chapter should cover a coherent stretch of work, not every tool call. A typical session has 3–8 chapters. Do not mark a chapter for the very first message — the session start is implicit.

The title is a short noun phrase ("Codebase exploration", "Auth bug fix", "Test verification"), not a sentence.

tools.description:
Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. Your current turn continues uninterrupted.

The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

schema.name: mcp__ccd_session__spawn_task
schema.description:
Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. Your current turn continues uninterrupted.

The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

title.description: Under 60 chars. Imperative action phrase (start with a verb), e.g. "Fix stale README badge", "Remove dead config option". Shown as the chip label and the spawned session title.

prompt.description: The initial message for the spawned session. Self-contained — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation. Not shown directly in the UI.

tldr.description: One or two plain-English sentences shown on the suggestion card under the title. Lead with why you are suggesting this now — name what you noticed in this session — then say what the new session will do. Keep it readable: no file paths or code.

cwd.description: Optional. Absolute path to a different project root than the current session's — a path on the host this session runs on. The spawned session gets a fresh worktree under this path. Defaults to the current project — only set this when the work clearly belongs in another repo on that host.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

$uxb = '.\bin\uxb_kilavuz_20261007.exe'
$k = "$sp\k.uxb"
function Say($ad, [string[]]$a) {
    $q = Join-Path $sp ("fiil_" + $ad)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $q | Out-Null
    $out = & $uxb @a --out-root $q 2>&1 | Out-String
    $kod = $LASTEXITCODE
    $f = @(Get-ChildItem $q -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $ek = ($f | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'execution|x64_mir|\.asm$|mir_verify|canonical_mir|semantic_mir' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($q.Length + 1) } | Select-Object -First 6) -join '; '
    "{0,-4} kod={1} dosya={2} {3}" -f $ad, $kod, $f.Count, $ek
}
Say 'lex' @('lex', $k)
Say 'par' @('par', $k)
Say 'ast' @('ast', $k)
Say 'sem' @('sem', $k)
Say 'hir' @('hir', $k)
Say 'mir' @('mir', $k)
Say 'mirS' @('mir', $k, '--semantic')
Say 'int' @('int', $k)
Say 'run' @('run', $k)
Say 'x64' @('x64', $k)
Say 'fmt' @('fmt', $k)
Say 'map' @('map', $k)
Say 'doc' @('doc', $k)
Say 'rel' @('rel', $k)
Say 'chk' @('chk', $k)
"--- uzanti iletileri ---"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$sp\var.bi", "x`r`n"); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$sp\var.txt", "x`r`n")
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$sp\komutlar.uxcli", "run`r`n$k`r`n")
foreach ($a in @("$sp\var.bi", "$sp\var.txt", "@$sp\komutlar.uxcli", "$sp\var.uxmh")) { $o = (& $uxb run $a 2>&1 | Out-String) -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ERROR' } | Select-Object -First 1; "{0} -> kod={1} {2}" -f (Split-Path $a -Leaf), $LASTEXITCODE, $o }
"--- semantic klasoru, bayraklar verilince ---"
Get-ChildItem "$sp\q2" -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'semantic' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring("$sp\q2".Length) }

content.thinking: Olmayan bir `.uxb` dosyasının da "Desteklenmeyen uzantı" diye raporlandığını ve uzantı alanının boş kaldığını buldum. Kayıtlara geçmeden önce 2.3–2.6'daki build ve DLL iddialarını da topluca işlemek için o bölümü yeniden okuyorum.

content.content:
56	   görüntüyü yan tarafa (`uxb.exe.replaced_<zaman>`) alır.
57	6. Günlüğü `reports/libraries/logs/compiler_x64_fbc.log` dosyasına yazar.
58	
59	Seçenekler: `-Release` (varsayılan, en iyilemeli), `-Debug` (hata ayıklama bilgili), `-Force`. Birlikte `-Release -Debug` verilemez.
60	
61	### 2.3.2 Elle `fbc` komutuyla
62	
63	Betiğin arkasındaki asıl komut (kayıt: `compiler/scripts/build_uxb_main_64.ps1`):
64	
65	```
66	fbc64.exe -v -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -O 2 -strip -x bin\uxb.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
67	```
68	
69	Hata ayıklama sürümü için `-O 2 -strip` yerine `-g` yazılır:
70	
71	```
72	fbc64.exe -v -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -g -x bin\uxb_hata_ayikla.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
73	```
74	
75	| `fbc` bayrağı | Anlamı |
76	|---|---|
77	| `-v` | Ayrıntılı çıktı (hangi araç hangi sırayla çalıştı) |
78	| `-lang fb` | FreeBASIC'in kendi dil kipi |
79	| `-gen gas64` | x64 için GNU assembler üretimi (32 bit için `-gen gas`) |
80	| `-w all` | Bütün uyarıları aç |
81	| `-exx` | Genişletilmiş çalışma zamanı denetimi (dizi sınırı, boş işaretçi) |
82	| `-mt` | Çok iş parçacıklı çalışma zamanı kitaplığı |
83	| `-O 2` | Orta düzey eniyileme |
84	| `-strip` | Sembol bilgisini ayıkla (daha küçük dosya) |
85	| `-g` | Hata ayıklama bilgisi ekle (`-O 2 -strip` ile birlikte kullanılmaz) |
86	| `-x <dosya>` | Çıktı dosyasının adı |
87	
88	> **Önemli kural:** Derleme çıktısı mimari denetiminden geçer. Betik, üretilen dosyanın gerçekten x64 olduğunu PE başlığından
89	> okur; farklıysa `Compiler host mimarisi yanlis` hatasıyla durur (kapalı başarısızlık).
90	
91	### 2.3.3 Başka bir adla derleme (eski sürümü bozmadan)
92	
93	Bir değişikliği denerken çalışan `bin/uxb.exe` dosyasını ezmeyin; yeni bir adla derleyin ve eski sürümle yan yana karşılaştırın:
94	
95	```
96	tools\FreeBASIC-1.10.1-win64\fbc64.exe -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -O 2 -strip -x bin\uxb_deneme.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
97	```
98	
99	### 2.3.4 32 bit sunucu (isteğe bağlı)
100	
101	Varsayılan olarak yalnızca x64 derleyici üretilir. 32 bit eşlik dosyası için ortam değişkeni verilir:
102	
103	```
104	$env:UXB_BUILD_X86 = '1'; .\build_64.ps1 -Force
105	```
106	
107	## 2.4 Çalışma zamanı DLL'ini derleme (`uxb_runtime.dll`)
108	
109	Görevler (`SPAWN`, `THREAD`, …), SHELL ve bazı çalışma zamanı işlevleri C++ ile yazılmış bu kütüphanededir.
110	
111	```
112	.\native\uxb_runtime\build_runtime_dll.ps1 -Variant auto
113	```
114	
115	| `-Variant` | Ne içerir? |
116	|---|---|
117	| `auto` | libuv ve oneTBB bulunduysa ikisini de kullanır (varsayılan) |
118	| `std` | Yalnızca standart C++ `std::thread` yedek yolu |
119	| `libuv` | libuv ile (olay döngüsü, iş kuyruğu) |
120	| `tbb` | oneTBB ile (görev grupları) |
121	| `full` | libuv + oneTBB zorunlu; eksikse hata verir |
122

Seçenekler: `-Release` (varsayılan, en iyilemeli), `-Debug` (hata ayıklama bilgili), `-Force`. Birlikte `-Release -Debug` verilemez.

### 2.3.2 Elle `fbc` komutuyla

Betiğin arkasındaki asıl komut (kayıt: `compiler/scripts/build_uxb_main_64.ps1`):

```
fbc64.exe -v -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -O 2 -strip -x bin\uxb.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
```

Hata ayıklama sürümü için `-O 2 -strip` yerine `-g` yazılır:

```
fbc64.exe -v -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -g -x bin\uxb_hata_ayikla.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
```

| `fbc` bayrağı | Anlamı |
|---|---|
| `-v` | Ayrıntılı çıktı (hangi araç hangi sırayla çalıştı) |
| `-lang fb` | FreeBASIC'in kendi dil kipi |
| `-gen gas64` | x64 için GNU assembler üretimi (32 bit için `-gen gas`) |
| `-w all` | Bütün uyarıları aç |
| `-exx` | Genişletilmiş çalışma zamanı denetimi (dizi sınırı, boş işaretçi) |
| `-mt` | Çok iş parçacıklı çalışma zamanı kitaplığı |
| `-O 2` | Orta düzey eniyileme |
| `-strip` | Sembol bilgisini ayıkla (daha küçük dosya) |
| `-g` | Hata ayıklama bilgisi ekle (`-O 2 -strip` ile birlikte kullanılmaz) |
| `-x <dosya>` | Çıktı dosyasının adı |

> **Önemli kural:** Derleme çıktısı mimari denetiminden geçer. Betik, üretilen dosyanın gerçekten x64 olduğunu PE başlığından
> okur; farklıysa `Compiler host mimarisi yanlis` hatasıyla durur (kapalı başarısızlık).

### 2.3.3 Başka bir adla derleme (eski sürümü bozmadan)

Bir değişikliği denerken çalışan `bin/uxb.exe` dosyasını ezmeyin; yeni bir adla derleyin ve eski sürümle yan yana karşılaştırın:

```
tools\FreeBASIC-1.10.1-win64\fbc64.exe -lang fb -gen gas64 -w all -exx -mt -O 2 -strip -x bin\uxb_deneme.exe compiler\wrappers\uxb_main_wrapper.bas
```

### 2.3.4 32 bit sunucu (isteğe bağlı)

Varsayılan olarak yalnızca x64 derleyici üretilir. 32 bit eşlik dosyası için ortam değişkeni verilir:

```
$env:UXB_BUILD_X86 = '1'; .\build_64.ps1 -Force
```

## 2.4 Çalışma zamanı DLL'ini derleme (`uxb_runtime.dll`)

Görevler (`SPAWN`, `THREAD`, …), SHELL ve bazı çalışma zamanı işlevleri C++ ile yazılmış bu kütüphanededir.

```
.\native\uxb_runtime\build_runtime_dll.ps1 -Variant auto
```

| `-Variant` | Ne içerir? |
|---|---|
| `auto` | libuv ve oneTBB bulunduysa ikisini de kullanır (varsayılan) |
| `std` | Yalnızca standart C++ `std::thread` yedek yolu |
| `libuv` | libuv ile (olay döngüsü, iş kuyruğu) |
| `tbb` | oneTBB ile (görev grupları) |
| `full` | libuv + oneTBB zorunlu; eksikse hata verir |

Betiğin kullandığı derleme komutunun özü (g++, MSYS2 UCRT64):

```
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -DUXB_RT_BUILD_DLL -shared -I<kaynak> \
    [-DUXB_WITH_LIBUV] [-DUXB_WITH_TBB] uxb_runtime.cpp uxb_runtime_mir.cpp uxb_runtime_state.cpp \
    uxb_runtime_task.cpp uxb_runtime_task_v2.cpp uxb_runtime_sync.cpp uxb_runtime_shell.cpp \
    backends/*.cpp [libuv bayrakları] [tbb bayrakları] \
    -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -Wl,--enable-auto-import -Wl,--out-implib,libuxb_runtime.dll.a -o uxb_runtime.dll
```

Çıkan `uxb_runtime.dll`, `bin/`, `dist/runtime_ext/` ve `dist/libraries/bin/` klasörlerine kopyalanır; gerekli bağımlı DLL'ler
(`libwinpthread-1.dll`, varsa `libuv-1.dll`, `libtbb12.dll`) de aynı yerlere konur. **Bir uXBasic EXE'sinin yanında bu DLL bulunmalıdır.**

Ortam değişkenleri: `UXB_GXX` / `CXX` (g++ yolu), `UXB_MINGW_ROOT`, `UXB_PKG_CONFIG` (libuv/oneTBB bayraklarını bulmak için).

## 2.5 EXE üretiminin iç yolu

`uxb bld` komutu şu zinciri çalıştırır (ayrıntıyı `exe_artifact_manifest.json` dosyasında görebilirsiniz):

```

```

* Birinci adım derleyicinin içindedir.
* İkinci adım: `%UXB_ASM_CMD% -f win64 program.asm -o obj/program.obj`
* Üçüncü adım: `%UXB_LINK_CMD% @program_link_args.rsp -o program.exe` (bağlayıcı olarak FreeBASIC kullanılır)

`UXB_ASM_CMD` ve `UXB_LINK_CMD` ortam değişkenleri, kullanılacak NASM ve bağlayıcı komutunu belirtir.

## 2.6 Test paketleri

Bütün dil davranış paketlerini tek komutla çalıştırmak için:

```

        toplam.ADD(1)
    NEXT i
    RETURN n
END THREAD
DIM g AS TASKGROUP
DIM k AS I64
FOR k = 1 TO 3
    g.ADD(SPAWN Isci(10000))
NEXT k
g.JOIN()
PRINT toplam

Private Sub InteropWriteToolchainEnv(ByVal tf As Integer, ByRef toolchain As InteropToolchainConfig)
    Print #tf, "@echo off"
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CC=" & toolchain.cc
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CXX=" & toolchain.cxx
    Print #tf, "set UXB_ASM=" & toolchain.asmCompiler
    Print #tf, "set UXB_LINK=" & toolchain.linker
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CC_PATH=" & toolchain.ccPath
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CXX_PATH=" & toolchain.cxxPath
    Print #tf, "set UXB_ASM_PATH=" & toolchain.asmPath
    Print #tf, "set UXB_LINK_PATH=" & toolchain.linkPath
    Print #tf, "set UXB_TARGET_ARCH=" & toolchain.targetArch
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CC_CMD=%UXB_CC%"
    Print #tf, "set UXB_CXX_CMD=%UXB_CXX%"
    Print #tf, "set UXB_ASM_CMD=%UXB_ASM%"
    Print #tf, "set UXB_LINK_CMD=%UXB_LINK%"
    Print #tf, "if not ""%UXB_CC_PATH%""=="""" set UXB_CC_CMD=%UXB_CC_PATH%\%UXB_CC%"
    Print #tf, "if not ""%UXB_CXX_PATH%""=="""" set UXB_CXX_CMD=%UXB_CXX_PATH%\%UXB_CXX%"
    Print #tf, "if not ""%UXB_ASM_PATH%""=="""" set UXB_ASM_CMD=%UXB_ASM_PATH%\%UXB_ASM%"
    Print #tf, "if not ""%UXB_LINK_PATH%""=="""" set UXB_LINK_CMD=%UXB_LINK_PATH%\%UXB_LINK%"
    Print #tf, "if /I ""%UXB_CC%""==""gcc"" if exist ""C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe"" set UXB_CC_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe"
    Print #tf, "if /I ""%UXB_CXX%""==""g++"" if exist ""C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\g++.exe"" set UXB_CXX_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\g++.exe"
    Print #tf, "if /I ""%UXB_ASM%""==""nasm"" if exist ""C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\nasm.exe"" set UXB_ASM_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\nasm.exe"
    Print #tf, "if /I ""%UXB_LINK%""==""gcc"" if exist ""C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe"" set UXB_LINK_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe"
    Print #tf, "exit /b 0"
End Sub

Private Function InteropWriteImportSteps(ByRef manifest As InteropManifest, ByRef outputDir As String, ByVal mf As Integer, ByVal rf As Integer, ByVal pf As Integer, ByVal bf As Integer) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim importCount As Integer
    importCount = 0

    Print #pf, "# Import compile steps"
    Print #bf, "@echo off"
    Print #bf, "setlocal EnableExtensions"
    Print #bf, "pushd ""%~dp0\..\..\.."""
    Print #bf, "if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1"
    Print #bf, "call ""%~dp0toolchain.env.bat"""
    Print #bf, "if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1"
    Print #bf, "if not exist ""%~dp0import_objs"" mkdir ""%~dp0import_objs"""
    Print #bf, "echo [interop] toolchain source: " & manifest.toolchain.sourceTag
    Print #bf, "echo [interop] cc=%UXB_CC_CMD% cxx=%UXB_CXX_CMD% asm=%UXB_ASM_CMD% link=%UXB_LINK_CMD%"
    Print #bf, "echo [interop] compiling imports..."

    For i = 0 To manifest.importCount - 1
        importCount += 1
        Dim objPath As String
        objPath = BuildObjectPath(outputDir, importCount, manifest.imports(i).importPath)

        Dim compileCmd As String
        compileCmd = BuildCompileCommand(manifest.imports(i).language, manifest.imports(i).importPath, objPath, manifest.toolchain)

        Print #mf, "IMPORT," & CsvEscape(manifest.imports(i).language) & "," & CsvEscape(manifest.imports(i).sourceFile) & "," & CsvEscape(manifest.imports(i).importPath) & "," & CsvEscape(objPath) & "," & CsvEscape(compileCmd) & "," & CsvEscape(objPath) & "," & CsvEscape(manifest.toolchain.sourceTag)
        Print #rf, BuildRspArgPath(objPath)
        Print #pf, compileCmd

--- interop\toolchain.env.bat ---
@echo off
set UXB_CC=gcc
set UXB_CXX=g++
set UXB_ASM=nasm
set UXB_LINK=gcc
set UXB_CC_PATH=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin
set UXB_CXX_PATH=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin
set UXB_ASM_PATH=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin
set UXB_LINK_PATH=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin
set UXB_TARGET_ARCH=x64
set UXB_CC_CMD=%UXB_CC%
set UXB_CXX_CMD=%UXB_CXX%
set UXB_ASM_CMD=%UXB_ASM%
set UXB_LINK_CMD=%UXB_LINK%
if not "%UXB_CC_PATH%"=="" set UXB_CC_CMD=%UXB_CC_PATH%\%UXB_CC%
if not "%UXB_CXX_PATH%"=="" set UXB_CXX_CMD=%UXB_CXX_PATH%\%UXB_CXX%
if not "%UXB_ASM_PATH%"=="" set UXB_ASM_CMD=%UXB_ASM_PATH%\%UXB_ASM%
if not "%UXB_LINK_PATH%"=="" set UXB_LINK_CMD=%UXB_LINK_PATH%\%UXB_LINK%
if /I "%UXB_CC%"=="gcc" if exist "C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe" set UXB_CC_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe
if /I "%UXB_CXX%"=="g++" if exist "C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\g++.exe" set UXB_CXX_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\g++.exe
if /I "%UXB_ASM%"=="nasm" if exist "C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\nasm.exe" set UXB_ASM_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\nasm.exe
if /I "%UXB_LINK%"=="gcc" if exist "C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe" set UXB_LINK_CMD=C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe
exit /b 0
--- build_program.bat ---
@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions
pushd "%~dp0\..\.."
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
call "%~dp0interop\toolchain.env.bat"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
if not exist "%~dp0obj" mkdir "%~dp0obj"
"%UXB_ASM_CMD%" -f win64 "%~dp0program.asm" -o "%~dp0obj\program.obj"
if errorlevel 1 (
  popd
  exit /b 1

Private Sub InteropToolchainApplyPolicy(ByRef tc As InteropToolchainConfig, ByRef policyText As String, ByRef sourceTag As String)
    Dim src As String
    src = Trim(policyText)
    If src = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim cursorPos As Integer
    cursorPos = 1

    Do While cursorPos <= Len(src)
        Dim sepPos As Integer
        sepPos = InStr(cursorPos, src, ";")

        Dim segment As String
        If sepPos = 0 Then
            segment = Mid(src, cursorPos)
            cursorPos = Len(src) + 1
        Else
            segment = Mid(src, cursorPos, sepPos - cursorPos)
            cursorPos = sepPos + 1
        End If

        segment = Trim(segment)
        If segment <> "" Then
            Dim eqPos As Integer
            eqPos = InStr(segment, "=")
            If eqPos > 1 Then
                Dim k As String
                Dim v As String
                k = Left(segment, eqPos - 1)
                v = Mid(segment, eqPos + 1)
                ApplyToolchainKeyValue tc, k, v, sourceTag
            End If
        End If
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub InteropToolchainApplyHostFallbacks(ByRef tc As InteropToolchainConfig)
    Dim cbRoot As String
    cbRoot = "C:\Program Files\CodeBlocks\MinGW\bin"

    If Trim(tc.asmPath) = "" And UCase(Trim(tc.asmCompiler)) = "NASM" Then
        If Dir(cbRoot & "\nasm.exe") <> "" Then
            tc.asmPath = cbRoot
            tc.sourceTag = "host-fallback:codeblocks"
        End If
    End If

    If Trim(tc.ccPath) = "" And UCase(Trim(tc.cc)) = "GCC" Then
        If Dir(cbRoot & "\gcc.exe") <> "" Then
            tc.ccPath = cbRoot
            tc.sourceTag = "host-fallback:codeblocks"
        End If
    End If

    If Trim(tc.cxxPath) = "" And (UCase(Trim(tc.cxx)) = "G++" Or UCase(Trim(tc.cxx)) = "GCC") Then
        If Dir(cbRoot & "\g++.exe") <> "" Then

            tc.sourceTag = "host-fallback:codeblocks"
        End If
    End If

    If Trim(tc.linkPath) = "" And UCase(Trim(tc.linker)) = "GCC" Then
        If Dir(cbRoot & "\gcc.exe") <> "" Then
            tc.linkPath = cbRoot
            tc.sourceTag = "host-fallback:codeblocks"
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub CollectInlineToolchainHints(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef sourceFile As String, ByRef tc As InteropToolchainConfig)
    Dim i As Integer
    i = 0

    Do While i < ps.lx.tokens.count
        Dim tk As Token
        tk = ps.lx.tokens.items(i)

        If InteropInlineIsKw(tk, "INLINE") Then
            i += 1
            If i < ps.lx.tokens.count AndAlso InteropInlineIsOp(ps.lx.tokens.items(i), "(") Then
                i += 1

                Dim args(3) As String
                Dim okHeader As Integer
                okHeader = 1

                Dim argIdx As Integer
                For argIdx = 0 To 3
                    If InteropInlineReadHeaderArg(ps, i, args(argIdx)) = 0 Then
                        okHeader = 0
                        Exit For
                    End If

                    If argIdx < 3 Then
                        If i >= ps.lx.tokens.count OrElse InteropInlineIsOp(ps.lx.tokens.items(i), ",") = 0 Then
                            okHeader = 0
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        i += 1
                    End If
                Next argIdx

                If okHeader <> 0 Then
                    If i < ps.lx.tokens.count AndAlso InteropInlineIsOp(ps.lx.tokens.items(i), ")") Then
                        Dim sourceTag As String
                        sourceTag = "inline:" & sourceFile & ":" & LTrim(Str(tk.lineNo))
                        InteropToolchainApplyPolicy tc, args(3), sourceTag
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If

        i += 1
    Loop
End Sub

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [string]$Uxb = ".\bin\uxb.exe",
  # Yalnız belirli paketleri koşmak için: -Only oop_parity,iterators
  [string[]]$Only = @(),
  # Hızlı tur: yalnız AST + canonical-MIR yerine tüm dört motor değil, paketin kendi koşucusu ne yapıyorsa o.
  [string]$ReportPath = ".\test_results\model_suite_summary.md",
  # Varsayilan: her uxb cagrisinin urettigi build\<zaman> klasoru (S-117: ~1,7 MB, FFI'li programlarda +53 MB DLL)
  # gecici bir --out-root altina yonlendirilir ve koşu bitince silinir. Klasorleri build\ altinda tutmak icin:
  [switch]$KeepBuildFolders
)
# S-072 (ilk parça): dil davranış paketlerinin TEK koşucusu.
# Her paket kendi klasöründeki run_*.ps1 ile çalışır (AST, canonical-MIR, native x64, legacy AST-x64;
# beklenen çıktı expected/<ad>.txt, hata metni expected/<ad>.contains.txt, motor süzgeci expected/<ad>.engines.txt).
# Bu betik: hepsini sırayla koşar, "Toplam/PASS/FAIL" satırını okur, tek tablo yazar, bir paket bile
# düşerse çıkış kodu 1 verir. Sessiz atlama yoktur: bir koşucu çalışmazsa o paket "CALISMADI" sayılır ve tabloda görünür.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$root = (Get-Location).Path

$suites = @(
  @{ Name = "compiler_consolidation"; Script = "tests\compiler_consolidation\run_consolidation_tests.ps1"; Konu = "matris, dosya/metin, SELECT, DIM, DECLARE, PRINT, float/property ve Win64 ABI" },
  @{ Name = "numeric_model";   Script = "tests\numeric_model\run_numeric_model_tests.ps1";      Konu = "U64/I64/dar tamsayi/onaltilik literal" },
  @{ Name = "library_type_contract"; Script = "tests\library_type_contract\run_library_type_tests.ps1"; Konu = "LIBTYPE lifecycle, RATIONAL deger aktarimi ve provider tanilari (MIR)" },
  @{ Name = "abi_model";       Script = "tests\abi_model\run_abi_model_tests.ps1";              Konu = "SIZEOF, F80 ABI, TYPE alanlari, VARPTR(a(i))" },
  @{ Name = "memoryref_model"; Script = "tests\memoryref_model\run_memoryref_model_tests.ps1";  Konu = "MemoryRef bolge/omur denetimi" },
  @{ Name = "memory_model";    Script = "tests\memory_model\run_memory_model_tests.ps1";        Konu = "AUTO/NATIVE/VIRTUAL, VARPTR, isaretci aritmetigi" },
  @{ Name = "array_params";    Script = "tests\array_params\run_array_param_tests.ps1";         Konu = "dizi parametreleri + sinir denetimi" },
  @{ Name = "sadd_model";      Script = "tests\sadd_model\run_sadd_model_tests.ps1";            Konu = "SADD, CODEPTR, LPTR" },
  @{ Name = "language_guards"; Script = "tests\language_guards\run_language_guard_tests.ps1";   Konu = "rezerve adlar, bellek deyimleri kapisi" },
  @{ Name = "oop_parity";      Script = "tests\oop_parity\run_oop_parity_tests.ps1";            Konu = "OOP: sanal dagitim, SUPER, miras, erisim, null alici" },
  @{ Name = "array_bounds";    Script = "tests\array_bounds\run_array_bounds_tests.ps1";        Konu = "LBOUND/UBOUND: sabit, REDIM, parametre, cok boyutlu (AST/MIR/x64/legacy/JS)" },
  @{ Name = "iterators";       Script = "tests\iterators\run_iterator_tests.ps1";               Konu = "FOR EACH / DO EACH" },
  @{ Name = "typed_task";      Script = "tests\typed_task_routines\run_typed_task_tests.ps1";   Konu = "tipli gorev rutinleri" },
  @{ Name = "task_model";      Script = "tests\task_model\run_task_model_tests.ps1";            Konu = "S-030 SPAWN/TASK/TASKGROUP + S-146 izolasyon: AST/MIR/native x64 calisir, legacy temiz red (expected\_engines.txt)" },
  @{ Name = "program_end";     Script = "tests\program_end\run_program_end_tests.ps1"; Konu = "S-156: rutin/ic ice ifade icindeki END programi bitirir (AST/MIR/x64; legacy rutin ici acik red)" },
  @{ Name = "string_lifetime"; Script = "tests\string_lifetime\run_string_lifetime_tests.ps1"; Konu = "S-157/S-158: STRING degisken/dizi/alan/yerel donus metni ezilmez; AST TYPE/CLASS STRING alanlari (AST/MIR/x64)" },
  @{ Name = "task_native";     Script = "tests\task_native\run_task_native_tests.ps1";          Konu = "S-030 Faz 2A: native gercek eszamanlilik (iptal, ic ice SPAWN, PRINT satiri, isci 1/2/AUTO x3)" },
  @{ Name = "task_sync";       Script = "tests\task_sync\run_task_sync_tests.ps1";              Konu = "S-146 Model D: otomatik senkron, LOCK, MUTEX, ATOMIC, UNSAFE ve kilitlenme tanilari (AST/MIR/x64; legacy acik red)" },
  @{ Name = "routine_scope";   Script = "tests\routine_scope\run_routine_scope_tests.ps1";     Konu = "S-167/S-168: BYREF gercek takma ad (ic ice, takas, ozyineleme, STRING); rutin yereli/parametresi ayni adli globali golgeler (AST/MIR/x64; legacy BYREF acik red)" },
  @{ Name = "exceptions_cross"; Script = "tests\exceptions_cross\run_exceptions_cross_tests.ps1"; Konu = "S-160: THROW/ASSERT rutin sinirini gecer; cagirandaki TRY yakalar, TRY disinda program durur, gorevde gorev hatasi; LOCK CATCH girisinde birakilir (AST/MIR/x64; legacy acik red)" },
  @{ Name = "uxgsl";           Script = "tests\libraries\uxgsl\run_uxgsl_smoke_tests.ps1";       Konu = "uxgsl (GSL) dort motorda; callback yalniz native" },
  @{ Name = "uxraylib";        Script = "tests\libraries\uxraylib\run_uxraylib_smoke_tests.ps1"; Konu = "uxraylib Image API (CPU-tarafi) dort motorda" },
  @{ Name = "uxsdl3";          Script = "tests\libraries\uxsdl3\run_uxsdl3_smoke_tests.ps1";     Konu = "uxsdl3 (SDL3): pencere/cizim/girdi/gamepad/ses/dosya sistemi, basliksiz (dummy surucu), dort motorda" },
  @{ Name = "const_scope";     Script = "tests\const_scope\run_const_scope_tests.ps1";            Konu = "CONST kapsami: modul/NAMESPACE/rutin ici, tamsayi/F64/STRING, golgeleme; bes motor (S-140)" },
  @{ Name = "float_text";      Script = "tests\float_text\run_float_text_tests.ps1";              Konu = "ondalik sayi metni: F64 16 / F32 7 hane, ilave sifir yok, ayni kural tum motorlarda (S-142b)" },
  @{ Name = "wasm_model";      Script = "tests\wasm_model\run_wasm_model_tests.ps1";              Konu = "WASM/WAT: global degisken/dizi, golgeleme (node ile gercek calistirma)" },
  @{ Name = "cli_flags";       Script = "tests\cli_flags\run_cli_flag_tests.ps1";               Konu = "CLI fiil/bayrak: help, version, --max-steps" }
)
if ($Only.Count -gt 0) {
  $unknownSuites = @($Only | Where-Object { $_ -notin $suites.Name })
  if ($unknownSuites.Count -gt 0) { throw ('Unknown test suite: ' + ($unknownSuites -join ', ')) }
  $suites = $suites | Where-Object { $Only -contains $_.Name }
}

$results = @()
$started = Get-Date
$scratch = $null
$UxbLabel = $Uxb
if (-not $KeepBuildFolders) {
  $scratch = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("uxb_model_runs_" + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8))
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $scratch | Out-Null
  $realUxb = (Resolve-Path $Uxb).Path
  $wrapper = Join-Path $scratch "uxb_wrap.cmd"
  # her cagriya --out-root eklenir; cikis kodu aynen iletilir
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($wrapper, "@echo off`r`n`"$realUxb`" %* --out-root `"$scratch\runs`"`r`nexit /b %ERRORLEVEL%`r`n", [Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
  $Uxb = $wrapper
}
try {
foreach ($s in $suites) {
  $scriptPath = Join-Path $root $s.Script
  $row = [ordered]@{ Paket = $s.Name; Konu = $s.Konu; Toplam = 0; Gecen = 0; Kalan = 0; Durum = "CALISMADI"; Sure = 0 }
  if (-not (Test-Path $scriptPath)) { $row.Durum = "KOSUCU-YOK"; $results += [pscustomobject]$row; continue }
  $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  # *>&1: paketlerin Write-Host (PASS/FAIL) satırları da yakalanır, konsolu doldurmaz
  $out = & $scriptPath -Uxb $Uxb *>&1 | Out-String
  $sw.Stop()
  $row.Sure = [int]$sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds
  $m = [regex]::Match($out, "Toplam:\s*(\d+)\s+PASS:\s*(\d+)\s+FAIL:\s*(\d+)")
  if ($m.Success) {
    $row.Toplam = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value; $row.Gecen = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value; $row.Kalan = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
    $row.Durum = if ($row.Kalan -eq 0 -and $row.Toplam -gt 0) { "GECTI" } else { "DUSTU" }
  }
  if ($row.Durum -ne "GECTI") {
    # düşen/çalışmayan paketin kanıtı: FAIL satırları
    # FAIL satiri + hemen ardindaki "beklenen/gelen" satirlari (kanit kaybolmasin)
    $lines = $out -split "`r?`n"
    $failParts = @()
    for ($li = 0; $li -lt $lines.Count -and $failParts.Count -lt 24; $li++) {
      if ($lines[$li] -match "FAIL ") { $failParts += $lines[$li]; if ($li + 1 -lt $lines.Count) { $failParts += $lines[$li + 1] }; if ($li + 2 -lt $lines.Count) { $failParts += $lines[$li + 2] } }
    }

# 2. Derleyiciyi FreeBASIC ile derleme ve komut satırı (CLI)

Bu bölüm iki şeyi anlatır: **(a)** uXBasic derleyicisinin kendisini FreeBASIC ile nasıl derleyeceğinizi, **(b)** derleyiciyi
komut satırından nasıl kullanacağınızı.

## 2.1 Gereken araçlar

| Araç | Ne için? | Nerede? | Zorunlu mu? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **FreeBASIC 1.10.1 (win64)** | uXBasic derleyicisini derler | `tools/FreeBASIC-1.10.1-win64/fbc64.exe` (projede hazır gelir) | Derleyiciyi derlemek için **evet** |
| **PowerShell 7** | Derleme ve test betikleri | Sistem | Betikleri kullanacaksanız evet |
| **MSYS2 UCRT64 (g++, libuv, oneTBB)** | `uxb_runtime.dll` (çalışma zamanı) derlemesi | `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin` | Yalnız çalışma zamanını yeniden derlemek için |
| **NASM** | x64 hedefinde assembly → nesne dosyası | PATH'te `nasm` ya da `UXB_ASM_CMD` | `uxb bld` ile EXE üretmek için **evet** |
| **Bağlayıcı (FreeBASIC/gcc)** | Nesne dosyasını EXE'ye bağlar | `UXB_LINK_CMD` | `uxb bld` için evet |
| **Node.js** | JS ve WASM çıktısını çalıştırmak/sınamak | `node` | Yalnız JS/WASM denemesi için |
| **wabt (wat2wasm)** | WAT metnini WASM ikilisine çevirir | `tools/wabt/bin/wat2wasm.exe` | WASM üretimi için evet |

## 2.2 Proje dizini

| Klasör | İçeriği |
|---|---|
| `src/` | Derleyicinin FreeBASIC kaynağı (`main.bas` giriş noktası; `lexer`, `parser`, `semantic`, `mir`, `codegen`, `interpreter`, `cli`, `preprocessor`, `surface` …) |
| `compiler/` | Derleme betikleri (`scripts/build_uxb_main_64.ps1`) ve sarmalayıcı (`wrappers/uxb_main_wrapper.bas`) |
| `native/uxb_runtime/` | C++ çalışma zamanı (`uxb_runtime.dll`): görevler, eşzamanlılık, SHELL |
| `include/modules/` | Standart kütüphane başlıkları (`*.uxmh`) |
| `libsx/` | Kütüphane kaynakları (örn. `uxsdl3`, `uxraylib`) |
| `runtime_ext/` | Kütüphane adaptörleri (DLL tarafı) |
| `bin/` | Derlenmiş araçlar: `uxb.exe`, çalışma zamanı DLL'leri |
| `tests/` | Model test paketleri (`run_all_model_tests.ps1`) |
| `tools/` | FreeBASIC, wabt, kitap/üretici araçları |
| `docs/tasarim/` | Tasarım kararları (bu kılavuzun dayanağı) |
| `docs/kitaplar/` | Doğrulanmış örnekler ve kitap araçları |
| `docs/uxbasic_5_cilt/` | Kaynak odaklı 5 ciltlik kitaplık (ayrıntılı derleyici/FFI konuları) |
| `build/` | Her çalıştırmanın çıktı klasörleri (tarih-saat adlı) |
| `ai_koordinasyon/` | Geliştirme defterleri: durum, sorun takibi, karar günlüğü |

## 2.3 Derleyiciyi derleme

### 2.3.1 Tek komutla

Proje kökünde (`uxb/`):

```
.\build_64.ps1 -Force
```

`-Force`, kaynak değişmemiş olsa bile yeniden derlemeyi zorlar. Bu betik `compiler/scripts/build_uxb_main_64.ps1` dosyasını çağırır.
Yaptığı işler:

1. `tools/FreeBASIC-1.10.1-win64/fbc64.exe`'nin varlığını denetler.
2. `PATH`'e FreeBASIC'in `bin\win64`, `bin\win32`, `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin` ve `tools\wabt\bin` klasörlerini ekler.
3. Giriş kaynağı olarak `compiler/wrappers/uxb_main_wrapper.bas` dosyasını (varsa) yoksa `src/main.bas` dosyasını seçer.
4. `fbc64` ile derler (aşağıdaki komut).
5. Çıkan dosyayı `bin/uxb.exe` olarak yerleştirir; `bin/uxb_x64.exe`, kökteki `uxb.exe` ve
   `compiler/wrappers/uxb_main_wrapper_64.exe` kopyalarını yazar. Çalışan bir `uxb.exe` üzerine yazılamayacağı için eski
   görüntüyü yan tarafa (`uxb.exe.replaced_<zaman>`) alır.

    if kimlik in mevcut:
        print("ZATEN VAR, atlandı:", kimlik)
        continue
    a = kimlik.rsplit("-", 1)[0]
    son = max((i for i, s in enumerate(satirlar) if s.startswith(a + "-") and " :: " in s), default=None)
    if son is None:
        while satirlar and not satirlar[-1].strip():
            satirlar.pop()
        satirlar.append(satir)
        satirlar.append("")
    else:
        satirlar.insert(son + 1, satir)
    print("eklendi:", kimlik)
open(YOL, "wb").write(sonu.join(satirlar).encode("utf-8"))
print("tamam")

KIMLIK = re.compile(r"G-([A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ]+)-(\d+)")


def katalog_oku():
    kayit = {}
    sira = []
    for s in open(SINIRLAR, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
        if not s.strip() or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        p = [x.strip() for x in s.split(" :: ")]
        if len(p) != 5 or not KIMLIK.fullmatch(p[0]):
            print("UYARI: bozuk katalog satırı atlandı:", s[:70])
            continue
        kayit[p[0]] = tuple(p[1:])
        sira.append(p[0])
    return kayit, sira


def esleme_oku():
    e = {}
    if os.path.exists(ESLEME):
        for s in open(ESLEME, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
            m = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(G-[A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ]+-\d+)\s*=\s*(S-\d+)\s*", s)
            if m:
                e[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
    return e


def kisa_baslik(olur, sinir=118):
    """Açıklamanın ilk cümlesi (ters tırnak içindeki noktalar sayılmaz), tek satır."""
    kes = len(olur)
    ters = False
    for i, c in enumerate(olur):
        if c == "`":
            ters = not ters
        if not ters and c == "." and i + 1 < len(olur) and olur[i + 1] == " ":
            kes = i
            break
    t = olur[:kes].strip()
    if len(t) > sinir:
        t = t[:sinir].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + " …"
    if t.count("`") % 2:
        t += "`"
    return t


def kayit_metni(no, kimlik, v, satir_sonu):
    etk, tur, olur, yap = v
    tarih = BULUNDU.get(kimlik, VARSAYILAN_TARIH)
    oncelik = TUR_SIRASI.index(tur) + 1 if tur in TUR_SIRASI else 9
    baslik = kisa_baslik(olur)
    s = [
        f"## S-{no} — [{kimlik}] {baslik} ({etk})",
        f"**Bulundu:** {tarih} (Claude, Kılavuz V2 örnek doğrulaması ve yoklama koşuları) · **Durum:** `ACIK` · **Tür:** {tur} (öncelik {oncelik}/6) · **Etkilenen:** {etk} · **Kılavuz kaydı:** {kimlik} · Denenen derleyici: `bin\\uxb_kilavuz_20261007.exe`",
        olur,
        f"**Geçici çözüm (kılavuzda önerilen, sorunu ÇÖZMEZ):** {yap}",
        f"**Hedef:** {TUR_HEDEF.get(tur, '')}",
        "**Kök neden:** araştırılmadı; gözlem kılavuz yazımı sırasında yapıldı. En küçük yeniden üretim, Kılavuz V2'nin ilgili bölümündeki örnek ve Ek G satırıdır "
        "(`docs/tasarim/uXBasic_Hedeflenen_Sistem_ve_Kullanma_Kilavuzu_V2_TR.md`).",
        "**Düzeltme:** yok. Kabul ölçütü: kayıttaki program AST, MIR, x64 ve JS'te (WASM destekliyorsa onda da) hedef davranışı verir; bu program yeni bir model "
        "testi olarak eklenir. Testi geçecek biçimde değiştirmek ya da beklentiyi gevşetmek çözüm sayılmaz.",
        "",
    ]
    return satir_sonu.join(s) + satir_sonu


def dizin_metni(kayit, esleme):
    sira = sorted(kayit, key=lambda k: (TUR_SIRASI.index(kayit[k][1]) if kayit[k][1] in TUR_SIRASI else 9, k))
    sat = ["# Kılavuz V2 sorun dizini (önerilen düzeltme sırası)", "",
           "Bu dosya `python tools/kitap/kilavuz_v2/sorun_takibe_isle.py` ile üretilir; kaynağı `tools/kitap/kilavuz_v2/veri/sinirlar.txt` kataloğudur.",
           "Her satırın ayrıntısı `SORUN_TAKIP.md` içindeki S-numaralı kayıttadır. Sıra: önce yanlış sonuç veren (SESSİZ), sonra çökme, motorlar arası fark, açık ret, eksik özellik, yavaşlık.",
           "", "| Tür | Kayıt sayısı | Anlamı |", "|---|---|---|"]
    for t in TUR_SIRASI:
        n = sum(1 for k in kayit if kayit[k][1] == t)
        sat.append(f"| {t} | {n} | {TUR_ACIKLAMA[t]} |")
    sat += ["", "| Sıra | Sorun | Kılavuz kaydı | Tür | Etkilenen | Belirti |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for i, k in enumerate(sira, 1):
        etk, tur, olur, _ = kayit[k]
        sat.append(f"| {i} | {esleme.get(k, '—')} | {k} | {tur} | {etk} | {kisa_baslik(olur, 90).replace('|', '/')} |")
    sat.append("")
    return "\n".join(sat)

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--dene", action="store_true", help="dosyaya yazmadan ne yapılacağını göster")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    kayit, katalog_sirasi = katalog_oku()
    esleme = esleme_oku()
    yeni = [k for k in katalog_sirasi if k not in esleme]
    print(f"katalog: {len(kayit)} kayıt · eşlemesi olan: {len(esleme)} · yeni: {len(yeni)}")
    if not yeni:
        open(DIZIN, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(dizin_metni(kayit, esleme))
        n = 0 if a.dene else capraz_basvuru(esleme)
        print(f"yeni kayıt yok; dizin yenilendi; çapraz başvuru eklenen kayıt: {n}")
        return
    ham = open(TAKIP, "rb").read()
    metin = ham.decode("utf-8")
    satir_sonu = "\r\n" if "\r\n" in metin else "\n"
    satirlar = metin.split(satir_sonu)
    numaralar = [int(m.group(1)) for s in satirlar for m in [re.match(r"^## S-(\d+)\b", s)] if m]
    en_buyuk = max(numaralar)
    son_s = max(i for i, s in enumerate(satirlar) if re.match(r"^## S-\d+\b", s))
    ekleme_yeri = next((i for i in range(son_s + 1, len(satirlar)) if satirlar[i].startswith("## ")), len(satirlar))
    print(f"SORUN_TAKIP: en büyük S-{en_buyuk}, ekleme satırı {ekleme_yeri + 1}")
    # Önerilen sıraya göre numara ver (düzeltme sırası = numara sırası)
    sirali = sorted(yeni, key=lambda k: (TUR_SIRASI.index(kayit[k][1]) if kayit[k][1] in TUR_SIRASI else 9, katalog_sirasi.index(k)))
    ilk = en_buyuk + 1
    dizin_no = ilk
    # Özet kayıt yalnız ilk toplu işlemede açılır; sonraki artımlı çalıştırmalarda yalnız tek tek kayıtlar eklenir (sıra tablosu dizin dosyasındadır).
    ozet_yaz = len(esleme) <= 1
    atanan = {}
    for i, k in enumerate(sirali):
        atanan[k] = ilk + (1 if ozet_yaz else 0) + i
    sayilar = {t: sum(1 for k in sirali if kayit[k][1] == t) for t in TUR_SIRASI}
    ozet = [
        f"## S-{dizin_no} — Kılavuz V2 sınır kataloğu: {len(sirali)} kusur ayrı kayıt olarak sıraya alındı (S-{ilk + 1} … S-{ilk + len(sirali)})",
        f"**Bulundu:** 2026-10-11 (Claude, Kılavuz V2 hazırlığı) · **Durum:** `ACIK` · Kaynak: `tools/kitap/kilavuz_v2/veri/sinirlar.txt` (Ek G)",
        "Kılavuz V2'nin hazırlığı sırasında gerçek derleyiciyle (`bin\\uxb_kilavuz_20261007.exe`) bulunan kusur ve sınırların TAMAMI burada ayrı ayrı kayıtlanmıştır. "
        "Numara sırası önerilen düzeltme sırasıdır: " + ", ".join(f"{t} {sayilar[t]}" for t in TUR_SIRASI) + ". "
        "Eşleme ve sıra tablosu: `ai_koordinasyon/KILAVUZ_V2_SORUN_DIZINI.md` (G-kaydı ↔ S-numarası); eşleme dosyası `tools/kitap/kilavuz_v2/veri/sorun_eslemesi.txt`.",
        "Kural (Mete, 2026-10-11): bu kayıtlar testi geçecek biçimde değiştirilerek kapatılmaz; kılavuzdaki geçici çözümler yalnız okuyucuya yol göstermek içindir ve "
        "sorunu çözmez. Gerçek çalışmada olması gereken davranış ve planlanan hedef her kayıtta yazılıdır.",
        "",
    ]
    blok = satir_sonu.join(ozet) + satir_sonu if ozet_yaz else ""
    for k in sirali:
        blok += kayit_metni(atanan[k], k, kayit[k], satir_sonu)
    if a.dene:
        print(blok[:3500])
        print(f"... toplam {len(blok)} karakter, {len(sirali)} kayıt (S-{ilk}…S-{ilk + len(sirali)})")
        return
    # yaz: aradan başkası dosyayı değiştirdiyse vazgeç
    once = os.path.getmtime(TAKIP)
    yeni_satirlar = satirlar[:ekleme_yeri] + blok.rstrip(satir_sonu).split(satir_sonu) + [""] + satirlar[ekleme_yeri:]
    if os.path.getmtime(TAKIP) != once:
        print("HATA: SORUN_TAKIP.md okurken değişti; yeniden çalıştırın")
        sys.exit(1)
    open(TAKIP, "wb").write(satir_sonu.join(yeni_satirlar).encode("utf-8"))
    with open(ESLEME, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        for k in sirali:
            f.write(f"{k} = S-{atanan[k]}\n")
    esleme.update({k: f"S-{n}" for k, n in atanan.items()})
    open(DIZIN, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(dizin_metni(kayit, esleme))
    n = capraz_basvuru(esleme)
    print(f"yazıldı: S-{min(atanan.values())}…S-{max(atanan.values())} ({len(sirali)} kayıt{', özet S-' + str(dizin_no) if ozet_yaz else ''}); eşleme ve dizin güncellendi; çapraz başvuru: {n}")

input.old_string:
Çıkan `uxb_runtime.dll`, `bin/`, `dist/runtime_ext/` ve `dist/libraries/bin/` klasörlerine kopyalanır; gerekli bağımlı DLL'ler
(`libwinpthread-1.dll`, varsa `libuv-1.dll`, `libtbb12.dll`) de aynı yerlere konur. **Bir uXBasic EXE'sinin yanında bu DLL bulunmalıdır.**

Ortam değişkenleri: `UXB_GXX` / `CXX` (g++ yolu), `UXB_MINGW_ROOT`, `UXB_PKG_CONFIG` (libuv/oneTBB bayraklarını bulmak için).
input.new_string:
Çıkan `uxb_runtime.dll`, `bin/`, `dist/runtime_ext/` ve `dist/libraries/bin/` klasörlerine kopyalanır; gerekli bağımlı DLL'ler
(`libwinpthread-1.dll`, varsa `libuv-1.dll`, `libtbb12.dll`, `libgcc_s_seh-1.dll`, `libstdc++-6.dll`) de aynı yerlere konur. **Bir uXBasic EXE'sinin yanında bu DLL bulunmalıdır;** `uxb bld` bunları EXE'nin klasörüne kendisi kopyalar (2.5).

**Yalıtılmış derleme.** Çalışan sürümleri bozmadan denemek için iki parametre vardır:

| Parametre | Anlamı |
|---|---|
| `-OutputDirectory <klasör>` | DLL'i ve dosyalarını `native\uxb_runtime\build\` yerine verilen klasöre yazar |
| `-SkipPublish` | `bin\`, `dist\` klasörlerine **hiçbir kopya yazmaz**; günlük ve `build_result.json` çıktı klasöründe kalır (`published: false`) |

```
.\native\uxb_runtime\build_runtime_dll.ps1 -Variant auto -OutputDirectory $env:TEMP\rt_deneme -SkipPublish
```

Bu kılavuz yazılırken `-Variant std` (44 sn) ve `-Variant auto` (29 sn) bu biçimde derlenmiştir: `std` yukarıdaki g++ komutunu `-DUXB_WITH_*` bayrakları **olmadan**, `auto` ise `-DUXB_WITH_LIBUV -DUXB_WITH_TBB` ile çalıştırır;
üretilen DLL'ler `std` için 3 338 011 bayt, `auto` için 3 357 526 bayttır (aynı kaynaktan her derlemede aynı boyut çıkar).

Ortam değişkenleri: `UXB_GXX` / `CXX` (g++ yolu), `UXB_MINGW_ROOT`, `UXB_PKG_CONFIG` (libuv/oneTBB bayraklarını bulmak için).

input.old_string:
`uxb bld` komutu şu zinciri çalıştırır (ayrıntıyı `exe_artifact_manifest.json` dosyasında görebilirsiniz):

```
program.uxb ─(MIR)→ program.asm ─(nasm -f win64)→ obj/program.obj ─(bağlayıcı)→ program.exe
```

* Birinci adım derleyicinin içindedir.
* İkinci adım: `%UXB_ASM_CMD% -f win64 program.asm -o obj/program.obj`
* Üçüncü adım: `%UXB_LINK_CMD% @program_link_args.rsp -o program.exe` (bağlayıcı olarak FreeBASIC kullanılır)

`UXB_ASM_CMD` ve `UXB_LINK_CMD` ortam değişkenleri, kullanılacak NASM ve bağlayıcı komutunu belirtir.
input.new_string:
`uxb bld` komutu şu zinciri çalıştırır (ayrıntıyı çalıştırma klasöründeki `json\backend\x64\exe_artifact_manifest.json` dosyasında görebilirsiniz):

```
program.uxb ─(MIR)→ program.asm ─(nasm -f win64)→ obj/program.obj ─(bağlayıcı)→ program.exe
```

* Birinci adım derleyicinin içindedir.
* İkinci adım (`build_program.bat`): `"%UXB_ASM_CMD%" -f win64 program.asm -o obj\program.obj`
* Üçüncü adım (`link_program.bat`): `"%UXB_LINK_CMD%" @program_link_args.rsp -o program.exe`. Bağlayıcı olarak **MinGW `gcc`** kullanılır (FreeBASIC değil); argüman dosyasında yalnız `obj/program.obj` ve çalışma zamanı kitaplığının içe aktarma dosyası `libuxb_runtime.dll.a` vardır.
* Dördüncü adım: aynı betik, çalışma zamanı DLL'lerini EXE'nin klasörüne **kendisi kopyalar** (önce `native\uxb_runtime\build\`, bulamazsa `bin\` altından). `uxb_runtime.dll` hiçbir yerde bulunamazsa üretilen betik `[x64-build] missing uxb_runtime.dll` yazıp durur.

`UXB_ASM_CMD` ve `UXB_LINK_CMD` **ayar değildir**, betiklerin içinde kurulan sonuç değişkenleridir: `interop\toolchain.env.bat` bunları `UXB_ASM`, `UXB_LINK` ve `*_PATH` değerlerinden hesaplar.
Dışarıdan vermenin etkisi yoktur; bozuk bir değerle bile `bld` başarıyla biter. Hangi NASM ve bağlayıcının kullanılacağını **2.9'daki** değişkenlerle belirleyin.

**`bld` çıktı klasörü** (EXE'nin yazıldığı klasör; en küçük program için de aynı dosyalar oluşur):

| Dosya | Ne işe yarar? |
|---|---|
| `k.exe` | Üretilen program |
| `uxb_runtime.dll`, `libwinpthread-1.dll`, `libuv-1.dll`, `libtbb12.dll`, `libgcc_s_seh-1.dll`, `libstdc++-6.dll` | Çalışma zamanı ve bağımlıları; program görev kullanmasa bile **hepsi** konur (toplam yaklaşık 6,8 MB). EXE'yi taşırken birlikte taşıyın |
| `program.asm`, `obj\program.obj` | Üretilen assembly ve nesne dosyası |
| `build_all.bat`, `build_program.bat`, `link_program.bat`, `program_link_args.rsp` | Zinciri yeniden çalıştıran betikler. Bu bilgisayarın mutlak yollarını gömer; başka makineye taşınmaz |
| `interop\` | `toolchain.env.bat` (araç zinciri), `build_import.bat`, `link_command.bat` … (içe aktarma bildirimi olmasa da oluşur) |
| `codegen_status_report.md`, `build_all.stdout.txt`, `build_all.stderr.txt` | Rapor ve araç çıktıları |

Araç zinciri hatası `uxb bld` çıkış kodu **14** ve `build_all.bat failed with exit code 1` iletisiyle bildirilir; ayrıntı `build_all.stdout.txt` ve `build_all.stderr.txt` dosyalarındadır.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""18.6 'Bugün çalışan bağlantı yolları' tablosunu gerçek derleyicide sınar: her seçenek çalışır, dosya JSON/CSV mi, hangi anahtarlar var."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, csv, io
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
KOK = r"C:\Users\mete\Downloads\BasicOyunSource\UXBc_Clean\UXBc\uxb"
SP = r"C:\Users\mete\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mete-Downloads-BasicOyunSource-UXBc-Clean-UXBc-uxb\b85b832d-c86f-49e6-b0a0-47af736f8686\scratchpad\tarif_dene_1"
UXB = os.path.join(KOK, "bin", "uxb_kilavuz_20261007.exe")
BUYUK = os.path.join(SP, "buyuk.uxb")
K = os.path.join(SP, "k.uxb")
OUT = os.path.join(SP, "meta_out"); os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)


def kos(fiil, kaynak, *ek):
    p = subprocess.run([UXB, fiil, kaynak, *ek, "--out-root", os.path.join(OUT, "r")], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", cwd=KOK)
    return p.returncode, (p.stdout + p.stderr)


def ozet(dosya):
    if not os.path.exists(dosya):
        return "DOSYA YOK"
    b = os.path.getsize(dosya)
    if b == 0:
        return "0 BAYT"
    ham = open(dosya, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    if dosya.endswith(".json"):
        try:
            j = json.loads(ham)
        except Exception as e:
            return f"{b}B  JSON DEĞİL ({e})"
        if isinstance(j, dict):
            return f"{b}B  JSON anahtarlar: " + ", ".join(list(j.keys())[:14])
        if isinstance(j, list):
            return f"{b}B  JSON liste[{len(j)}] ilk eleman anahtarları: " + (", ".join(list(j[0].keys())[:12]) if j and isinstance(j[0], dict) else str(j[:2]))
    if dosya.endswith(".csv"):
        satir = ham.splitlines()
        return f"{b}B  CSV {len(satir)} satır, başlık: {satir[0][:150]}"
    return f"{b}B  {ham[:100]!r}"


DENE = [
    ("tokens", "lex", BUYUK, ["--tokens-json-out"], "tokens.json"),
    ("ast", "ast", BUYUK, ["--ast-json-out"], "ast.json"),
    ("mir (--semantic)", "mir", BUYUK, ["--semantic", "--mir-json-out"], "mir.json"),
    ("mir (semantic YOK)", "mir", BUYUK, ["--mir-json-out"], "mir_ss.json"),
    ("canonical-mir", "mir", BUYUK, ["--semantic", "--canonical-mir-json-out"], "cmir.json"),
    ("symbol-table", "sem", BUYUK, ["--symbol-table-json-out"], "sym.json"),
    ("type-table", "sem", BUYUK, ["--type-table-json-out"], "typ.json"),
    ("preprocess-result", "lex", BUYUK, ["--preprocess-result-json-out"], "pre.json"),
    ("type-infer csv", "sem", BUYUK, ["--type-infer-report-csv-out"], "tir.csv"),
    ("backend-matrix", "bld", K, ["--build-x64", "--build-x64-out", os.path.join(OUT, "bm.exe"), "--backend-matrix-json-out"], "bm.json"),
    ("backend-matrix (x64 fiili)", "x64", K, ["--backend-matrix-json-out"], "bm2.json"),
    ("backend-matrix (jsw)", "jsw", K, ["--js-out", os.path.join(OUT, "bm3.js"), "--backend-matrix-json-out"], "bm3.json"),
    ("manifest (jsw)", "jsw", K, ["--js-out", os.path.join(OUT, "m1.js"), "--manifest-out"], "man1.json"),
    ("manifest (jsw browser)", "jsw", K, ["--emit-browser", "--html-out", os.path.join(OUT, "m2.html"), "--js-out", os.path.join(OUT, "m2.js"), "--manifest-out"], "man2.json"),
    ("diag json", "run", os.path.join(SP, "hata.uxb"), [], None),
]
for ad, fiil, kaynak, ek, cikti in DENE:
    ek = list(ek)
    yol = None
    if cikti:
        yol = os.path.join(OUT, cikti)
        ek.append(yol)
    kod, metin = kos(fiil, kaynak, *ek)
    if cikti:
        print(f"[{ad}] kod={kod} -> {ozet(yol)}")
    else:
        ek2 = ["--diag-format", "json"]
        kod, metin = kos(fiil, kaynak, *ek2)
        ilk = metin[metin.find("{"):]
        try:
            j = json.loads(ilk[: ilk.rfind("}") + 1])
            print(f"[{ad}] kod={kod} -> JSON anahtarlar: {', '.join(list(j.keys())[:14])}")
            print("    örnek:", {k: (str(v)[:60]) for k, v in list(j.items())[:8]})
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[{ad}] kod={kod} JSON ayrıştırılamadı: {e}; ham: {metin[:300]!r}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""SORUN_TAKIP.md içindeki kayıtların yalnız **Durum:** değerini değiştirir ve kaydın sonuna bir 'Güncelleme' satırı ekler.
Eski metin silinmez. CRLF korunur. Okuma ile yazma arasında dosya değişirse vazgeçer."""
import os, re, sys, json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
TAKIP = r"C:\Users\mete\Downloads\BasicOyunSource\UXBc_Clean\UXBc\uxb\ai_koordinasyon\SORUN_TAKIP.md"


def uygula(guncellemeler, dene=False):
    once = os.path.getmtime(TAKIP)
    ham = open(TAKIP, "rb").read().decode("utf-8")
    sonu = "\r\n" if "\r\n" in ham else "\n"
    satirlar = ham.split(sonu)
    for no, (durum, metin) in guncellemeler.items():
        bas = next((i for i, s in enumerate(satirlar) if re.match(rf"^## {re.escape(no)}\b", s)), None)
        if bas is None:
            print("YOK:", no)
            continue
        bit = next((i for i in range(bas + 1, len(satirlar)) if satirlar[i].startswith("## ") or satirlar[i].startswith("### ")), len(satirlar))
        bulundu = next((i for i in range(bas + 1, bit) if satirlar[i].startswith("**Bulundu:**")), None)
        if bulundu is None:
            print("Bulundu satırı yok:", no)
            continue
        eski = re.search(r"\*\*Durum:\*\*\s*`([^`]+)`", satirlar[bulundu])
        if not eski:
            print("Durum alanı yok:", no)
            continue
        satirlar[bulundu] = satirlar[bulundu].replace(f"**Durum:** `{eski.group(1)}`", f"**Durum:** `{durum}`", 1)
        son = bit - 1
        while son > bas and not satirlar[son].strip():
            son -= 1
        if metin[:80] in "\n".join(satirlar[bas:bit]):
            print(f"{no}: güncelleme zaten ekli; atlandı")
            continue
        satirlar.insert(son + 1, metin)
        print(f"{no}: {eski.group(1)} -> {durum}; güncelleme satırı eklendi")
    if dene:
        return
    if os.path.getmtime(TAKIP) != once:
        print("HATA: dosya okurken değişti; yeniden çalıştırın")
        sys.exit(1)
    open(TAKIP, "wb").write(sonu.join(satirlar).encode("utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    veri = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
    uygula({k: (v["durum"], v["metin"]) for k, v in veri.items()}, dene="--dene" in sys.argv)

]
mevcut = {s.split(" ::", 1)[0] for s in satirlar if s.startswith("G-")}
for kimlik, satir in YENI:
    if kimlik in mevcut:

    a = kimlik.rsplit("-", 1)[0]

else:
    print("UYARI: G-HEDEF-20 eski cümle bulunamadı")

 ("G-CLI-16", "G-CLI-16 :: --manifest-out :: SESSİZ :: `jsw` fiiliyle `--emit-browser` olmadan `--manifest-out dosya.json` verilirse dosya yazılmaz ve uyarı çıkmaz (çıkış 0). Kayıt ölçütü \"schema/status alanları\" der, `schema` yoktur :: Yüzey × hedef bilgisi için `--runtime-route-matrix-json-out` (76 çalışma zamanı hizmeti × x64/js/wasm/browser) ve `--ast-json-out` içindeki düğüm başına `target_support` alanını kullanın"),
 ("G-CLI-18", "G-CLI-18 :: --diag-format json :: AÇIK :: Çıktı tek bir JSON belgesi değil, ayraçsız art arda yazılmış JSON nesneleridir (dizi değil). Ayrıştırma hatası her zaman iki nesne verir (ikincisi \"ayrıntılar `parse_errors.txt` dosyasına yazıldı\" işaretçisidir, konumu bilinmez: `line 0`, `known: false`), bu yüzden `json.loads(stdout)` \"Extra data\" ile düşer; anlam, sözcük ve çalışma anı hataları tek nesnedir.
